task.instruction: Search for a vegetarian lasagna recipe that has at least a four-star rating and over 500 reviews.

final_answer:
I recommend Artichoke Spinach Lasagna on Allrecipes: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20082/artichoke-spinach-lasagna/

It has a 4.6-star average from 1,824 ratings and 1,287 written reviews, so it clears both the four-star and 500-review thresholds. It's vegetarian. It uses artichoke hearts, spinach, onion, garlic, vegetable broth, mozzarella and feta, with no meat. Prep takes 20 minutes and cook time is 1 hour. Total time is 1 hr 20 mins, and it serves 8.

A second option is Simple Spinach Lasagna, with 565 ratings. I didn't check its star average or review count, so I can't confirm it meets your criteria.

judge.rationale: The final page shows Artichoke Spinach Lasagna with 4.6 stars, 1,287 reviews, and vegetarian ingredients/description, satisfying all criteria.
